currentParagraphText: “That is how it will be framed,” Jacob said as he walked forward, gazing out at the nearby land still filled with desolation. “The False God appeared amidst negotiations between the Chosen of the Malefic Viper and the Holy Church, disrupting everything and killing everyone present in the city besides a scarce few. During this slaughter, the Runemaiden was called to help take down the False God for good... everyone besides the four of us dying in the end.”
